selectedFix: Option A: Removed the duplicate top-level 'let activeTab = 'routes';' declaration at line 79 of src/main.js, preserving the authoritative 'let activeTab = 'today';' declaration at line 494.
whyNoBehaviorChanges: The variable activeTab represents the active sidebar tab state in src/main.js. Line 79 was a redundant top-level declaration initialized to 'routes', which was immediately superseded by line 494 initializing activeTab to 'today'.
